A bill for an act relating to natural resources; establishing the nature as we age grant program; appropriating money; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 84.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[84.977] NATURE AS WE AGE; GRANT PROGRAM. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Establishment.+]

[+The commissioner of natural resources must establish and administer a program to provide grants for natural-resource-based outdoor education and recreation opportunities for older adults. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Eligibility.+]

[+The commissioner may award grants under this section to public entities or private nonprofit organizations. +]

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+Priorities.+]

[+In awarding grants under this section, the commissioner must give priority to grants that: +]

[+(1) provide older adults with opportunities to directly experience nature and the natural world; +]

[+(2) maximize the number of participants that can be served; +]

[+(3) serve older adults with limited opportunities to participate in natural-resource-based outdoor activities; +]

[+(4) use public parks and other natural resource venues and personnel as a resource; and +]

[+(5) commit matching funds or in-kind resources. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the nature as we age grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 84.977. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; establishing the nature as we age grant program; appropriating money; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 84.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[84.977] NATURE AS WE AGE; GRANT PROGRAM.

Subdivision 1.

Establishment.

The commissioner of natural resources must establish and administer a program to provide grants for natural-resource-based outdoor education and recreation opportunities for older adults.

Subd. 2.

Eligibility.

The commissioner may award grants under this section to public entities or private nonprofit organizations.

Subd. 3.

Priorities.

In awarding grants under this section, the commissioner must give priority to grants that:

(1) provide older adults with opportunities to directly experience nature and the natural world;

(2) maximize the number of participants that can be served;

(3) serve older adults with limited opportunities to participate in natural-resource-based outdoor activities;

(4) use public parks and other natural resource venues and personnel as a resource; and

(5) commit matching funds or in-kind resources.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the nature as we age grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 84.977.
